XMLDB.COMMENT: DB schema for local_aiforumassist (AI Forum Assistant).

TABLE.NAME: local_aiforumassist_course
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-course configuration set by the teacher.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {course}.id. One row per course.

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = the assistant drafts answers in this course's active forums.

FIELD.NAME: waitminutes
FIELD.COMMENT: Minutes to wait after a question before drafting, so the teacher or classmates can answer first.

FIELD.NAME: helplevel
FIELD.COMMENT: guide = only orient on graded tasks; explain = explain concepts in more detail. Graded tasks are never solved.

FIELD.NAME: ainote
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = add 'Prepared with the help of AI' to the replies the teacher publishes.

FIELD.NAME: reminders
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = weekly reminder of upcoming due dates.

FIELD.NAME: reminderforumid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {forum}.id where reminders are posted; 0 = the course's announcements forum.

FIELD.NAME: reminderday
FIELD.COMMENT: ISO weekday of the reminder: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday.

FIELD.NAME: reminderhour
FIELD.COMMENT: Hour of the reminder, 0-23, in the site's time zone.

FIELD.NAME: reminderdays
FIELD.COMMENT: How many days ahead the reminder looks.

FIELD.NAME: remindermode
FIELD.COMMENT: draft = the teacher approves it; auto = posted by Tiko.

FIELD.NAME: lastreminder
FIELD.COMMENT: When the last weekly reminder was prepared.

FIELD.NAME: indexedtime
FIELD.COMMENT: When the course materials were last indexed; 0 = never.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {user}.id of the teacher who last changed the settings.

TABLE.NAME: local_aiforumassist_forum
TABLE.COMMENT: Forums of a course where the assistant drafts answers. No row = off.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {course}.id.

FIELD.NAME: forumid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {forum}.id.

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: draft = answers wait for the teacher. (auto arrives in v0.2.)

TABLE.NAME: local_aiforumassist_draft
TABLE.COMMENT: What the assistant prepared for the teacher: answer drafts, questions it could not answer, and reminder drafts.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {course}.id.

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: answer = drafted reply; question = needs the teacher (see reason); reminder = weekly reminder draft.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending | published | discarded

FIELD.NAME: forumid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {forum}.id.

FIELD.NAME: discussionid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {forum_discussions}.id of the question; 0 for reminders.

FIELD.NAME: postid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {forum_posts}.id of the student's question; 0 for reminders.

FIELD.NAME: authorid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {user}.id of the student who asked; 0 for reminders.

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: For kind=question: not_in_materials | graded_task | ai_error | daily_limit.

FIELD.NAME: subject
FIELD.COMMENT: Subject of the post to publish.

FIELD.NAME: message
FIELD.COMMENT: Drafted message (HTML), editable by the teacher.

FIELD.NAME: sources
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of the course modules the answer is based on: [{cmid, title}].

FIELD.NAME: publishedpostid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {forum_posts}.id of the published post.

FIELD.NAME: decidedby
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {user}.id of the teacher who published or discarded it.

TABLE.NAME: local_aiforumassist_chunk
TABLE.COMMENT: Index of a course's materials: text fragments used to answer questions. No personal data.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {course}.id.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {course_modules}.id; 0 for the course summary and section summaries.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the fragment comes from: activity name, chapter, file.

FIELD.NAME: chunkno
FIELD.COMMENT: Position of the fragment within its source.

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: Plain text of the fragment (about 300 words).

TABLE.NAME: local_aiforumassist_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Audit log of every AI call and every teacher decision.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {course}.id.

FIELD.NAME: draftid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {local_aiforumassist_draft}.id, when there is one.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {user}.id of the teacher who decided; 0 for calls made by the assistant in the background.

FIELD.NAME: action
FIELD.COMMENT: answer | reminder | publish | discard

FIELD.NAME: provider
FIELD.COMMENT: AI provider that handled the call.

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: Model, when it can be known.

FIELD.NAME: prompthash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the prompt.

FIELD.NAME: prompt
FIELD.COMMENT: Prompt sent to the AI (student names already replaced).

FIELD.NAME: response
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw AI response.

FIELD.NAME: error
FIELD.COMMENT: Error message when the call failed.
